tasks: All 35 original tasks: 25 short and 10 long; no omissions or deduplication
stopping: Fresh full-training ideal CE excess or FW gap, 64 updates, or 120 seconds including data construction and encoding checked between whole updates. Evaluation and replay are separate. Each process has a 600 second wall cap and 8 GiB address-space cap. Every failure is retained.
selection: No held-out selection, stopping, candidate choice or tuning. Evaluate every split only after the endpoint is fixed. Report both arms independently.
features: Unchanged query-aligned count features and joint coefficients from counts 281fb852. Context capacity reads declared input and rollout lengths only. No task identifier or answer rule enters the predictor.
scope: Controlled loss ablation after historical failures; not a new task family, multiple seeds, spectral-table comparison or matched transformer timing. Short/long are the original suite membership tiers, not new training budgets.
